name: Ponkotsu Nama Nushi Mirai-chan ~Ecchi na Comment Uketsukechuu~
original_name: ぽんこつ生主ミライちゃん～えっちなコメント受付中～
source:
The protagonist is a university student busy juggling part-time jobs.

They don’t have any major complaints about life—but something still feels a little lacking.

Living alone, which once seemed so exciting, has turned out to be surprisingly dull.

“I wish every day could be a little more fun…”

Then, a shy woman moves into the apartment next door.

There’s Mirai-chan, a streamer who actually knows who you are.

And her friend, Yukari-chan.

Meeting these women begins to change your life in unexpected ways.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01417859.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名忙于打工的大学生。

他们对生活没有什么大的抱怨，但仍然感觉有些欠缺。

曾经看似令人兴奋的独居生活，现在却变得出奇的乏味。

“我希望每一天都可以更有趣一点……”

然后，一个害羞的女人搬进了隔壁的公寓。

Mirai-chan是一位真正知道你是谁的主播。

还有她的朋友小由香里。

遇见这些女性开始以意想不到的方式改变你的生活。
